name: Grokbar
author: Derrick Egersdorfer
description: SuperGrok weekly pool on the bar, plus xAI API invoice spend.

barWidget.description: Bar widget with SuperGrok weekly pool. Scanner is a Rust binary.

schema.label: Show weekly usage
schema.description: Show weekly percent and reset on the bar. The click panel always shows the full breakdown.

schema.label: Show API billing
schema.description: Show the API invoice amount on the bar. The click panel always shows the bill.

schema.label: Pace warning
schema.description: Turn the bar red when weekly usage is ahead of an even burn through the week.

schema.label: Pace alarm floor
schema.description: Do not paint the chip urgent for even-burn over-pace until used percent reaches this fraction (0–1). 0.15 = 15%. Set 0 to match original grokbar (red at 3% in hour 1).

schema.label: xAI management key file
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to ~/dev/XAI-MGMT-KEY.txt or env XAI_MANAGEMENT_KEY. Team-scoped Management API key from console.x.ai — not an inference key.
